score_rationale: Real support pain and clear rules, but reporting needs and refund volume are unclear.
summary: Create partial refunds against existing invoices in EUR, GBP and JPY, capped at the amount paid, rounded to each currency's minor unit, with a reason and a monthly report.

gaps.question: Is the cap the amount paid or the invoice total, if partial payments exist?
Do refunds reverse tax proportionally?
gaps.why_it_matters: Finance reporting and compliance depend on it.

epics.title: Partial refunds against invoices
epics.description: Create a refund linked to an invoice, capped at the paid amount.
epics.source_quote: A refund can be partial and must never exceed the amount that was paid

stories.title: Create a partial refund for an invoice
acceptance_criteria: Refund above the paid amount is refused

epics.title: Currency-correct refund amounts
epics.description: Round refunds to each currency's minor unit.
epics.source_quote: Refund amounts must respect each currency's minor unit, so yen refunds have no decimals

epics.title: Refund reasons and reporting
epics.description: Record a reason per refund and list refunds per currency per month.
epics.source_quote: finance wants a monthly list of refunds per currency

stories.title: Require a refund reason
acceptance_criteria: Refund without a reason is refused

stories.title: Monthly refunds report per currency
acceptance_criteria: Report groups refunds by currency and month

director_report.summary: Removes manual calculator work for support and gives finance a monthly view.

director_report.decision_requested: Approve refunds with cap, per-currency rounding and reasons.
